comment: The Rail Theme menu offers Light, Dark and High Contrast, and res/rails holds -light.vgt, -dark.vgt and -high.vgt, but rails.cpp:13-15 returns the light file from all three accessors, so load_rail_themes loads -light.vgt three times, and the other two files are never read. This module has no parameters, inputs or outputs at all: every control on the panel is a plain widget, so nothing here can be tagged.
